description: Low-confidence generated skill draft should remain review-required and draft-only with no installed path.

input_pattern.canonical: maybe save this confusing intermittent debugging habit
examples: Maybe save this confusing intermittent debugging habit.
This might be a skill, but I am not sure what should trigger it.
We sometimes do this investigation, maybe keep it as a draft.

artifact_draft.name: intermittent-debugging-draft
artifact_draft.content:
# Intermittent Debugging Draft

## Trigger
Draft only. The repeated pattern is not yet specific enough to activate automatically.

## Workflow
1. Ask the reviewer to clarify the recurring trigger.
2. Keep the draft uninstalled until the trigger and verification path are concrete.
3. Convert to an installable skill only after review approval.

## Completion Evidence
- Draft remains outside installed skill paths.
- Review output states the missing trigger specificity.
- No automatic activation path is configured.
